title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics + parity/version bumps for python/ts/go
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: multiple SDK teams have duplicated auth and retry logic and divergent streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates the auth/retries behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, harmonizes streaming APIs (sync/async ergonomics), and bumps SDK versions for parity.

This is a cross-repo monorepo change that touches the three SDK packages and central docs/changelog. Goals:
- Provide a single semantic for credential resolution (env -> creds file -> metadata) with consistent token refresh behavior.
- Unify retry semantics (idempotency-based policy + default backoff) and expose sane hooks for users to override.
- Improve streaming ergonomics: Python async iterators, TS async generators + on('data') compatibility, Go streaming client with context cancellation and last-event reconciliation.
- Bring feature parity and version bumps: python v1.12.0 -> v1.109.0, typescript v1.12.0 -> v1.109.0, go v0.9.x -> v1.109.0 (single coordinated versioning for release script).

What changed (high level):
- sdk/python: refactor auth to AuthProvider, introduce RetryPolicy config, streaming client now yields chunks as Token objects and supports async for/iter. Updated docs and examples.
- sdk/typescript: align auth API surface with python (CredentialProvider), add default RetryStrategy, streaming client supports async generator and event emitter compatibility.
- sdk/go: new creds package, standardized retry middleware, streaming client supports context cancellation and simplified iterator API.
- docs: consolidated SDK auth guide, updated migration notes and changelogs.
- ci/workflows: added cross-sdk integration matrix and bumped release action to handle coordinated version tags.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc approved (Linear: ENG-4982)
- [x] Unit tests added for auth and retry logic in all SDKs
- [x] Streaming examples updated in examples repo
- [x] Changelogs updated for each SDK
- [x] Release automation updated to tag all three SDKs together

Testing notes: ran full unit + integration matrix on linux and mac runners. Initial TS unit job failed due to a race in emitter teardown; fixed by ensuring stream.end is idempotent. All CI checks green on final run.

Migration notes: see docs/sdks/migration-auth-retries.md (summary included in release notes). Breaking changes are limited to callers who relied on previous non-deterministic retry behavior or inspected internal token refresh internals. We added compatibility shims where feasible.

release_notes: Unified SDK auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Default retry policy now follows idempotency-aware backoff.
